changelog: Explore by Studios & Platforms: Browse your favorite movies and shows by streaming service or studio right from the home page.
Lightning Fast Performance: Massive speed improvements! Lists and cards now load instantly and scroll smoother than ever.
Windows 11 Snap Layouts: Easily organize your screen by snapping the app to the edges of your display.
Leave Spaces: You can now easily leave a Space whenever you want.

features.title: What's New
items: Studios & Providers on Home: We've added dedicated sections on the Home page to discover content by your favorite platforms (Netflix, HBO, etc.) and studios (Marvel, DC, etc.).
Click to Discover: Click on any provider logo to instantly explore their entire catalog in the Discover page.
Windows 11 Snap Layouts Support: Multitasking made easy! Hover over the maximize button to perfectly snap the app alongside other windows.
Leave a Space: You now have the option to leave a Space you no longer want to be a part of.

features.title: Better Experience
items: Ultra-Smooth Performance: We've optimized how lists and cards load under the hood, removing lags and making the app feel incredibly fast.
Quick Access to Spaces: Your Spaces are now included in the quick navigation menu so you can jump into them instantly.
Smart Version Checker: Watch Parties now check if everyone is using a compatible app version before joining to prevent connection issues.
Better List Sorting: Your lists now perfectly order your items so the most recent ones are exactly where you expect them.

features.title: Bug Fixes
items: Guest Watch History: Fixed an issue where the watch history for guests in a party wasn't being tracked properly.
Stable TV Show Browsing: Fixed a Watch Party bug where the host browsing TV series details could interrupt the sync for everyone else.
